entries.name: API Runtime Binding
invoke_when: A public API contract, generated client, backend route, or frontend API binding changes.
do_not_invoke_when: No API or runtime binding is affected.
entries.output_contract: API contract, route, generated-client, consumer, checks, decision, remaining risk.

entries.name: Cost-Aware Subagent Orchestrator
invoke_when: At least two independent bounded work units benefit from coordinated delegation without overlapping writes.
do_not_invoke_when: The task is small, indivisible, analysis-only, or the platform has no real subagent capability.
entries.output_contract: Unified work-unit results and one scoped decision; no self-granted formal approval.

entries.name: Current Workspace Authority
invoke_when: Repository, branch, commit, pull request, or remote audit state must be pinned.
do_not_invoke_when: The task contains no repository claim.
entries.output_contract: Repository, mode, branch, resolved commit SHA, and ref provenance.

entries.name: Docker Journey Runtime
invoke_when: Docker, data-plane, service startup, runtime smoke, database, Redis, MinIO, or live behavior is changed or claimed.
do_not_invoke_when: The task is static or documentation-only and makes no runtime claim.
entries.output_contract: Runtime command, immutable commit, environment, service health, smoke results, decision, and missing evidence.

entries.name: DSH WLT Finance Boundary
invoke_when: Checkout, payment, COD, commission, refund, settlement, payout, wallet, ledger, reconciliation, or a DSH/WLT financial handoff changes.
do_not_invoke_when: No financial truth or DSH/WLT handoff is affected.
entries.output_contract: DSH and WLT owner paths, financial invariants, contract and runtime evidence scopes, decision, and unresolved risk.

entries.name: Evidence Gate Router
invoke_when: A claim requires selection of static/code, contracts/data, runtime, visual/accessibility, security/privacy, finance, CI, or release/production evidence.
do_not_invoke_when: No verification or closure claim is requested.
entries.output_contract: Required evidence scope, selected checks or sources, and scoped decision.

entries.name: Final Journey Closure Judge
invoke_when: Final multi-dimensional closure is explicitly requested.
do_not_invoke_when: Only a code check, draft, diagnostic, or partial implementation is requested.
entries.output_contract: Exact candidate, applicable evidence, passed and failed scopes, blockers, residual risks, and final decision.

entries.name: CI Workflow Guardian
invoke_when: GitHub Actions workflows, local actions, or executable CI scripts change.
do_not_invoke_when: No executable CI code is affected.
entries.output_contract: Pinned ref, affected workflow code, syntax/security/pinning checks, exact-candidate run evidence, decision, and remaining risks.

entries.name: Independent Implementation Reviewer
invoke_when: A protected change requests independent implementation review.
do_not_invoke_when: The reviewer authored, executed, or coordinated the reviewed change.
entries.output_contract: Pinned ref, affected and forbidden paths, findings, evidence reconciliation, scoped decision, and remaining risks.

entries.name: Platform Runtime Config
invoke_when: Environment, provider, service slot, base URL, runtime map, CORS, or sensitive runtime configuration changes.
do_not_invoke_when: No runtime configuration or provider boundary is affected.
entries.output_contract: Configuration owner, consumers, sensitive-data review, runtime evidence requirement, decision, and remaining risk.

entries.name: Product Truth Governor
invoke_when: A user-visible, role-sensitive, cross-surface, commercial, or workflow capability changes.
do_not_invoke_when: The change is a behavior-preserving internal refactor with product impact explicitly declared as none.
entries.output_contract: Product Truth state, actors, surfaces, invariants, checks, and remaining risks.

entries.name: Screen Flow Binding
invoke_when: Routes, screens, states, actions, or controller binding change.
do_not_invoke_when: No user-facing or operator-facing flow changes.
entries.output_contract: Required surfaces, routes or screens, states, actions, bindings, checks, and gaps.

entries.name: Security Secrets Privacy
invoke_when: Authentication, authorization, sessions, secrets, credentials, PII, payment data, CORS, logs, or sensitive provider configuration changes.
do_not_invoke_when: No security, privacy, secret, or sensitive-data boundary is affected.
entries.output_contract: Sanitized findings, affected paths, security evidence, remediation, and residual risk.

entries.name: Service Fullstack Journey
invoke_when: A capability crosses contract, backend, data, shared state, and one or more surfaces.
do_not_invoke_when: The task is limited to one isolated layer with no cross-layer claim.
entries.output_contract: Product-to-contract-to-runtime chain, affected surfaces, checks, decision, and unresolved gaps.

entries.name: Universal Task Router
invoke_when: A repository task has unclear mode, risk, ownership, skill routing, or verification scope.
do_not_invoke_when: The request is unrelated to the repository or is a trivial explicit text-only edit.
entries.output_contract: Task mode, risk class, affected domains, required skills, forbidden scope, and verification route.
